observation.command: echo "=== docker config (login check) ==="; ls -la /root/.docker/config.json 2>&1; grep -o 'registry.opencode.de' /root/.docker/config.json 2>/dev/null && echo "has auth entry" || echo "no stored auth -> anonymous pull"; echo "=== cleanup my backup file ==="; rm -f /workspace/deployments/example-opencode/asr-service.cpu.default.yml.bak2 && echo "removed .bak2"; ls -la /workspace/deployments/example-opencode/*.bak* 2>/dev/null || echo "no leftover backup files"
